Raw hex address 0x50e002 assigned to bare local `uStack_1c4`. The decompiler dropped a symbolic reference — either a data-symbol pointer (recover the symbol from the .asm and replace `uStack_1c4` with symbolic global/array indexing, §11) or a dead code-address store from return-address tracking (delete it, §14). Magic addresses do not survive the relink.

Watcom shadow-pointer walk — `actor` self-updates via pointer arithmetic on its own `actor_name` field (which decays to a pointer), `+ CONST`; `offsetof(actor_name) + CONST*sizeof(elem)` equals the stride of a *different* array the loop reads through `actor`. Replace those `actor->other_field[0]` reads with direct indexing on the original pointer; drop the shadow init and self-update. (String/buffer-copy cursors that only touch the advanced field are excluded here — those are unrolled_strcpy/unrolled_memcpy.)

Watcom shadow-pointer walk — `this_ptr` self-updates via pointer arithmetic on an inner array field reached through a chained field path; the array decays to a pointer and `+ CONST` adds `CONST * sizeof(element)` bytes, matching the outer array stride. Replace `this_ptr->some_field[0]` reads with direct indexing on the original pointer; drop the shadow init and self-update.
